messages:
anika: Quick check — Tom's onsite got moved to Wed 10am PT. Can we confirm the panel and who will lead the debrief? Need a scribe too. @samir @june
samir: I can lead the debrief and run the system-design section. :+1:
june: I can scribe and capture notes in Notion. Will use the team debrief template. Posting link in a sec.
elena: Small question on rubric: for Senior Infra Eng role, hiring manager wants architecture weighted higher. Thinking 60% architecture / 40% implementation. Acceptable?
anika: Hiring manager already ok'd 60/40. I'll update the packet and the rubric doc. Also need candidate consent for recording the debrief (onsite + Zoom). @people-ops-bot can you confirm the exact wording to send?
people-ops-bot: Heads up — recordings require opt-in. Suggested wording: "We record debrief discussions for calibration and training. Recordings are internal and access-limited. Please let us know if you prefer not to be recorded." See policy: /policies/interview-recordings
samir: Can we also reserve a 15min buffer right after the interview for notes + quick calibration? Block should be in the invite.
june: I'll create the calendar invite with a 15m buffer and include the Notion debrief doc in the description: https://redwood-internal.notion/workspace/debrief-template (placeholder)
anika: Pasting the debrief rubric snippet we'll use so everyone is aligned:
```
- Problem framing (0-4)
- Solution design / architecture (0-6)
- Implementation & tradeoffs (0-4)
- Communication & collaboration (0-2)
```
samir: Note — during the coding portion, avoid giving hints. Use the 'independent problem solving' checkbox on the rubric.
june: Invite created. Samir — set as debrief lead; Anika on interview; I'm scribe. Calendar shows Room 3 + zoom bridge.
elena: Can ops confirm AV + Zoom bridge and that candidate was sent consent text?
people-ops-bot: AV confirmed: Room 3 reserved, Zoom bridge + recording enabled. Consent request sent to candidate via email.
anika: Great — closing loop. If anyone needs a swap, ping here and we'll arrange coverage. cc @recruiting
recruiting: Thanks — noted and will monitor opt-in response from candidate.
